tab.noDataTitle: No heart rate on this flight
tab.noDataBody: Heart rate appears here when your flight app records it from a chest strap into the IGC file.
tab.loadFailedBody: We-Fly reads it from your IGC file each time you open this tab. Try again in a moment.

timeline.title: Heart rate over the flight
timeline.description: Your pulse against your altitude. The dashed line is your average for the flight.
timeline.empty: No heart-rate readings during the flight.

distribution.title: Time in each heart-rate band
distribution.description: Minutes of flight spent in each 10 bpm band.
distribution.empty: No heart-rate readings during the flight.

phases.title: By flight phase
phases.description: Average heart rate in each phase, with its gap to your flight average. Bars start at {floor} bpm.
phases.empty: Not enough heart-rate readings in any one flight phase.

privacy: Heart rate is health data. We-Fly reads it from your IGC file when you open this tab and stores none of it. Anyone else who downloads this flight's file, from a shared link or the community, gets it without your heart rate.
